newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli planes rocket Lebanon for second day.
newsitem.headline: Israeli planes rocket Lebanon for second day.

text.p: Israeli warplanes on Wednesday rocketed suspected Moslem guerrilla targets in the mountains of south Lebanon, Lebanese security sources said.
Two planes fired a total of eight rockets into the rugged Iqlim al-Toufah ridge from which Hizbollah (Party of God) fighters mount attacks on Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, they said.
Lebanese army and Hizbollah anti-aircraft gunners fired at the planes, the sources added. There was no indication that they scored any hits and no immediate word on casualties in the air raid.
It was Israel's second air raid on south Lebanon in two days and the 27th against Lebanon this year.
On Tuesday, warplanes rocketed suspected Hizbollah bases in the Syrian-controlled eastern Bekaa Valley. A woman was injured in the leg by shrapnel.
Earlier on Wednesday the Israeli army said its troops killed a Hizbollah fighter and wounded others during an exchange of fire in the central sector of the zone.
Hizbollah guerrillas frequently attack Israeli troops in a bid to oust them and their local militia allies from the 15-km (nine miles)-wide border occupation zone.
